sealed_record.thesis: A single Hyperliquid wallet built a 94.7K CBRS ($17.4M) long between Friday's equity close and Sunday, lifting the price ~11% at peak — but it funded that position by cutting its MU, INTC and DRAM longs by a roughly matching dollar amount, so this was pure rotation, not new capital entering Cerebras. The tell is that CBRS fell 3% within minutes of the wallet stopping its adds, which means most of the weekend move was one participant's own price impact in a thin HIP-3 perp with no cash-equity arbitrage open to anchor it. The market is reading the hyperdash headline as 'smart money is bullish Cerebras' (the wallet is +$17M since mid-August off NEAR and INJ), when the real information is a self-marked position with no marginal buyer behind it and ~$50M of concentrated single-wallet inventory that must eventually be sold. Short into the inflated weekend mark and let cash-session repricing or the whale's own profit-taking do the work.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP +43.2%. Short ditutup untuk mengunci hasil saat seluruh buku call di-unwind.
